name: Personal news digest
description: Personalized RSS news and owner feedback, using native OpenClaw schedules and blogwatcher.

ownerId.description: Fixed Telegram owner user ID; defaults to TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.

timezone.description: Initial IANA timezone; later changes are stored in the news profile.

cliPath.description: Absolute OpenClaw JS entrypoint. Omit to use the openclaw executable from PATH.
